articles.title: Euro falls, set for fifth straight weekly drop as oil prices rise
articles.description: The euro has experienced a significant drop as concerns about France's public debt continue to affect investor confidence. Global bond markets have stabilized following US President Donald Trump's remarks on potential military action against Iran. Oil prices fluctuated significantly, impacting market dynamics and investor sentiment. US consumer sentiment has worsened amid rising living costs attributed to the ongoing Middle East conflict.

articles.title: Trump and Iran agree on one thing. The US election calendar isn't driving their decisions on the war
articles.description: President Donald Trump and Iranian officials seem to agree on one thing about their seven-month-old war. They each insist that the U.S. election calendar isn't motivating them to find an end to it. American concerns about high gas prices and inflation are hanging over the November 3 midterms. Despite economic sanctions and a naval blockade, Iran insists there will be no deal until the U.S. lifts these measures. Trump has dispatched more military resources to the region, but he's also declared he won't launch strikes before Nov. 3. Some Republicans are trying to distance themselves from Trump's stance, but it's challenging with the election so close.

articles.title: D-Street breaks 8-week losing run, outlook stays cautious though
articles.description: After an eight-week slump, Indian equities experienced a robust rebound, highlighted by a notable rise in the BSE Sensex. This recovery was buoyed by declining crude oil prices, which eased from their recent peaks. While foreign portfolio investors remained in a selling mood, local institutional investors stepped in with strong buying activity.
